hero.promise: Your technical partner to build your applications and bring AI into your business.
hero.sub: For ten years, I've been building web and mobile apps for teams in Europe and Canada, working remotely. Today I add AI to them when it genuinely saves time.

services.label: Services
services.title: What I can do for you.

poles.need: Build an application or an AI tool
poles.promise: A product or internal tool built around the way you work.
poles.useful: you are launching a product, or your team needs a tool that fits the way it works.
items: AI assistants that search and summarize your documents, with sources and access control
poles.receive: a product in production, its source code and the documentation to keep it moving.

poles.promise: Less copy-pasting between your tools, and fewer mistakes.
poles.useful: repetitive tasks keep your team busy across several tools.
items: Connecting your tools and moving data between them
Automatic handling of requests and documents
Automated chains of tasks, with human approval where needed
poles.receive: documented automations that you can monitor and adjust.

poles.promise: Pick up a project that's stuck and get it all the way to production.
poles.useful: the project is running late, the code is hard to change, or a prototype won't make it to production.
items: Taking over and evolving an existing application
Finishing prototypes built with Claude, Cursor or v0
poles.receive: a clear diagnosis, a prioritized fix plan and, if needed, its delivery.

poles.promise: Someone who knows your code and helps you make the call.
poles.useful: you need a technical lead over time, without hiring someone full time.
items: Tech lead, for architecture, code quality and mentoring developers
Part-time CTO, for the roadmap, priorities and technical trade-offs
Extra capacity for your team over a set period
Scoping AI projects and choosing the right solutions
Maintenance and improvements, at a pace we agree on
poles.receive: someone who follows your project closely, and technical choices explained in writing.

method.label: Approach
method.title: How a project unfolds.

items.title: Understand the need
items.description: We talk through your goals and constraints, then decide together what to build.

items.title: Propose a solution
items.description: An approach, clear deliverables and an estimate, before any work starts.

items.title: Build
items.description: The work moves forward in stages, with regular check-ins.

items.title: Deliver and hand over
items.description: Once you've approved it, I hand over the code, the documentation and the access. You're free to carry on with me or without me.

method.pilot: For an AI project, we can first test it on a small real case. You see what it does and what it costs, then decide whether to go further.

partners.label: Partnerships
partners.title: You have the client. I handle the tech.
partners.lead: Agency, design studio, consultant or founder, you own the client relationship or the product vision. I take care of the development.

points.title: Clear roles
points.text: You keep the client relationship, the design and the project management. I handle the development.

points.title: Inside your team
points.text: I join your team for a set period, with your tools and your ways of working. If I'm not available, I can suggest an associate developer.

points.title: A whole project
points.text: I can also take on the full development of a project, from approved mockups to launch. Applications, automations or taking over an existing project, as in my services.

partners.formatsLink: See the ways to work together

about.label: About
about.title: One technical point of contact.
about.lead: I'm your direct contact and the project's technical lead. No middleman or project manager between us.
about.bio: Depending on the project, I build on my own or with associate developers. I work remotely from Madagascar, with regular check-ins and decisions in writing.
about.team: I work with a small team of associate developers. If I'm already committed to other projects, I can suggest one of them, or a developer from my network.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Let's talk about your project.
contact.sub: 30 minutes, free. We look at what you need, and whether we're a good fit. I usually reply within 24 hours.
